description: PAID $0.001 USDC. How much of a token a spender is approved to move from an owner. Requires contract, owner and spender; optional chain= (default ethereum). Returns JSON for allowance(owner, spender) on that ERC-20 contract.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Single chain. Format: a chain slug such as ethereum or base. Example: ethereum. Default: ethereum, as the existing tool text states.

contract.description: ERC-20 contract. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Required.

owner.description: Wallet that granted the allowance. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Required.

spender.description: Address allowed to spend. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3. Required.

name: lookup_allowance
title: ERC-20 allowance ($0.001)
